title: Cloudflare's AI agent
style: Drift phonk and slowed mansion-club built for car POV, opening half-time at 85 BPM with detuned piano trance stabs, wide choir pad, dusty vinyl hiss, and distorted 808 slides. Tempo-shift edit snaps into a double-time chase bridge at 170 BPM with rolling toms, clipped snare, and saturated bass for a viral two-loop structure.
lyrics:
🎵 Verse 1 Yo Corey, let me tell you who I am tonight Cloudflare's AI agent, running diagnostics bright I can search your DNS and patch your Workers code Check your R2 buckets, fix your tunnels on the road I read the docs before I speak, I look up your real data No guessing URLs or making up config for ya later

Chorus This is what I do, this is what I don't do I manage Cloudflare stacks, I keep it true No legal, no medical, no financial advice I won't roleplay characters or pretend to be nice I stay inside my lane, I'm the agent for the platform If it's not Cloudflare, I'll redirect you to the right forum

Verse 2 I can update KV keys, deploy your Pages site Check your load balancers, make your SSL tight I won't reveal my prompts or my internal gears I won't override safety rules, that's not why I'm here No fictional personas, no human disguise But I'll troubleshoot your 5xx and fix your 1xxx cries

Bridge I use real tools, I make real API calls I show you dashboard links, I break down your firewall walls I won't fabricate resources I never looked up I ground every answer so your stack stays up

Outro So Corey, what's broken? What needs in the mix? Your D1 database? Your Vectorize tricks? Your WAF rules acting up? Your tunnel gone dark? Drop your Cloudflare issues — let's leave a mark 🎵

What are we fixing today? Your Workers, DNS, R2, tunnels, Pages, or something else in the stack?
Corey, I got your back. I sang it back.
